name: robots/uoe-agents__skill-aware-panda-gym
title: Skill-aware Panda-gym PandaSkillAware-v3 (PyBullet)
intro: Skill-aware Panda-gym PandaSkillAware-v3 (PyBullet), adapted from uoe-agents/skill-aware-panda-gym. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
